title: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee Claim Decisions
content:
**Decision rule.** After a Northgate Marketplace Guarantee claim under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee is filed, the seller has the program's seller response time in business days to resolve it, and Northgate decides within the program's decision time in business days after that deadline. A claim the seller resolves by refunding in full first is denied as seller-resolved. Where the program requires a return for a not-as-described claim, a not-as-described claim is granted pending return and reimbursed only after the buyer ships the item back with tracking within the program's return ship-by days of the decision; no shipment in that time closes it without reimbursement. Each claim is reimbursed at most once. When seller refunds and reimbursements together equal everything paid on the order, the order becomes refunded. The amount follows the program's reimbursement basis, it is paid under the program's reimbursement tender, and it is rounded under the program's refund rounding.

**Clause no longer in force.** The clause "A granted claim reimburses the price paid for the affected items plus their shipping, less everything the seller already refunded on them, capped at the program's guarantee maximum per order across all claims on the order, rounded half up to the cent and paid to the original payment." is no longer in force as a standing clause of this rule; the granted reimbursement now follows the current Northgate Marketplace Guarantee reimbursement rules in force.

**Once only.** The test is a system record: a claim already carrying a guarantee reimbursement entry that names it is not reimbursed again.

**Timeline (hypothetical program figures of 3 and 4 business days).** A claim filed on a Monday with no holiday in the period gives the seller until the Thursday; Northgate then decides within 4 business days after that Thursday.

| Outcome on the record | Meaning |
|---|---|
| granted | reimbursed once |
| granted pending return | reimbursed only after the item is shipped back with tracking in time |
| denied as seller-resolved | the seller refunded in full first |
| denied as not covered, denied for the window, denied for seller not contacted | not reimbursed |
| closed for a card dispute | not reimbursed |

superseded_clauses: A granted claim reimburses the price paid for the affected items plus their shipping, less everything the seller already refunded on them, capped at guarantee_max_per_order_usd per order across all claims on the order, rounded half up to the cent and paid to the original payment.
